question: Does disabling only the last4 spatial Hash feature levels improve displacement and P1 proxy joint development accuracy under the fixed geometry/BC recipe?

selection.policy: One preselected representation utility test after non-affine error diagnostic; no assumption that the observed error is caused by frequency

scope.cache_CADs: Only the existing40train+5validation groups. Canonical ver geometry and BC input metadata; no displacement/stress labels are read to build the graph.
scope.validation_geometry: Target-independent validation geometry/BC may be cached. No validation label is used to fit a normalizer or define graph features.

architecture.field_inputs: Fixed Euclidean43: original25 + local13 + same active nearest-interface Euclidean5, then actual query32/global32
architecture.encoded_order: level-major12x2=24 Hash features, followed by107 Identity conditions, followed by13 explicit constant-one channels; Network public input144
architecture.feature_mask: full12 multiplies all24 by1; coarse8 multiplies first16 by1,last8 by0. Same full12 Encoding is constructed and stored on both sides; no learned gate/head, no LoD binding/custom shader
architecture.mask_layout: First8 levels0..7 active, last4 levels8..11 inactive, two features per level; preserve public24 encoded width and padded144 network width
architecture.output: 9 response components in [ver,hor,tor] x [ux,uy,uz], combined with the unchanged external source-metadata alpha; common linear physical u decode.
architecture.force_moment_mask: Clear original slots7:13 upstream before predicting the common9-response basis; graph/context carry no alpha or force/moment values.
architecture.native_counts_status: Source-derived only; measure actual two public parameter buffers in one root-scheduled synthetic check before training
architecture.performance_limit: Post-encoding mask computes all12 levels on both sides; no encoding speedup claim
architecture.smoothness_limit: Linear Hash interpolation is continuous and piecewise differentiable; query/local geometry/ReLU conditions can still create short-scale variation

pair.only_mechanism_difference: Fixed mask removes only final8 encoded feature channels; same input values,caches,PointNet/query,layout and stored parameter count
pair.initial_forward_limit: Different masks affect natural predictions from initialization; do not force same outputs or add zero head. Equal complete named trainable parameters/native buffers and shared data/sampling remain required
pair.capacity_limit: coarse8 reduces effective usable spatial representation and trainable gradient paths, despite equal stored parameter count. Utility gain cannot identify frequency causality independently of capacity/optimization
pair.fixed_mask_buffers_policy: Any mode-specific nonlearned mask state must be explicitly excluded only from parameter-equality claim; no claim that differing mask buffers are identical
pair.old_checkpoint_limit: Neither historical fused Euclidean checkpoint nor old split learned-gate controls substitute for the new freshfull12 baseline

recipe.queries_per_case: 6400 uniform original nodes +1600 uniform tetra sets x4corners; duplicates retained
recipe.normalizer_reference: runs/geobc_exploration/displacement_query_context_actual_10k/config.json TRAIN120 scaler/u_loss records; direct reuse, no refit or recalibration
recipe.P1_reference: Existing TRAIN-only full-volume true-u cornerP1 denominators and unchanged45 CAD geometry caches; no stress/solver-strain constitutive scalar target
recipe.precision: FP32/high-TF32 PointNet/query; native FP16 compute/FP32 master; FP64 physical-mm cornerP1 losses and physical metrics
recipe.checkpoint_selection: Known-load validation15 all-original-node physical signed-u vector case-mean relativeL2 only; P1 at the same checkpoint
recipe.evaluation: Report train120/validation15 all-original-node physical U and incident-volume-averaged P1 tensor metrics, separately from sampled squared optimization losses

checks: Actual Encoding/Network dimensions and separate public FP32 parameter counts,with FP16 compute
Complete trainable initial hashes equal; declared nonlearned mask differences handled honestly
Actual last8 feature values pass through full12 and become exact0 in coarse8; full24 output layout preserved
First backward finite nonzero public Encoding/Network/PointNet/query paths in both modes; retained encoded activation gradients last8 exact0 forcoarse8,without guessing parameter partitions
Force7:13 perturbation leaves common load basis exactly unchanged

clear_gain_gate.comparator: Only this fresh split-native full12 versus fixedcoarse8 pair, each at its own u-only-selected checkpoint; coarse8 is the candidate and full12 the control
clear_gain_gate.P1_definition: Known validation15 case-mean all-original-node incident-volume-averaged cornerP1 symmetric-Frobenius relativeL2, squared shear weight2; not optimization cell squared loss or solver GT strain.
clear_gain_gate.P1_zero_tensor_baseline: RelativeL2=1 for the zero tensor on nonzero reference cases, independent of bandwidth_mode; there is no zero-input training branch.
clear_gain_gate.if_pass: Same matched pair seed2027 replication, subject to root selection/freeze; no retrospective threshold tuning.
clear_gain_gate.if_fail: Root selects one bounded task from the actual train/validation/representation evidence; no automatic second seed, extra mask group or cutoff/loss/radius/width sweep.

scientific_limits: Single paired seed2026 on reused known-load development validation; no final-test or significance claim.
P1 is u-derived corner FE proxy,not solver strain GT or sampled cell squared loss.
Fixed coarse8 is a bandwidth/capacity/optimization utility ablation,not proof of high-frequency Hash causality.
The motivating field diagnostic is one selected worst-TRAIN representative; no population attribution.
Both new split models are fresh controls; old fused or gate models are contextual only.
No cutoff,learning-rate,lambda,width,radius sweep or additional geometry features.
